decisions.reason: Its increasing visibility from a standalone page to the home page suggests performance at or above aspiration, and it fits the firm's strategic move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure services.

Although evidence is modest, it remained on the website and supports real-time provisioning and operational efficiency in the core voice business, so a large expanding firm with slack would likely continue it while results remain acceptable.

Its disappearance from the website soon after launch signals results below aspiration, and as a legacy telephony offer with weak fit to the firm's forward direction the resources are better redeployed.

The product was no longer mentioned after 2018, indicating underperformance relative to aspiration, and in a declining industry management would reallocate resources from a weak voice niche to stronger integrated infrastructure services.
